abstract: Tier-2 cell-mean predictions for the Silicon Sample Benchmark, produced by a single model (claude-fable-5) asked to forecast group means directly. Each call shows all 17 condition texts at once and asks for one outcome, so the 17 arms are ranked inside a single answer. The 44 raw survey items are predicted and the 6 composite outcomes are computed in code. Every cell is predicted 6 times, as 3 prompt framings (plain, population-profile, and a two-stage control-then-shift form) x 2 repeats; the submitted value is the ensemble mean, and the moderator file is reconciled to the main file using the population shares of a 9,000-profile GSS-based synthetic sample. No human outcome data from this study informed any part of the pipeline.
approach_family: cell-level direct forecast; single model; prompt ensemble (3 framings x 2 repeats, mean); item-level prediction with composites computed in code; zero-shot
